name: 01 · Basic contact search
description: A simple starting table, selected fields, filters and sort order.
xml:
<fetch top="50">
  <entity name="contact">
    <attribute name="fullname" />
    <attribute name="emailaddress1" />
    <attribute name="createdon" />
    <filter type="and">
      <condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0" />
      <condition attribute="emailaddress1" operator="not-null" />
    </filter>
    <order attribute="fullname" descending="false" />
  </entity>
</fetch>

name: 02 · Account to primary contact
description: An inner join showing where a related contact field comes from.
xml:
<fetch top="100">
  <entity name="account">
    <attribute name="name" />
    <attribute name="accountnumber" />
    <link-entity name="contact" from="contactid" to="primarycontactid" link-type="inner" alias="primarycontact">
      <attribute name="fullname" alias="primary_contact_name" />
      <attribute name="emailaddress1" />
      <filter><condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0" /></filter>
    </link-entity>
    <order attribute="name" />
  </entity>
</fetch>

name: 03 · Case and customer relationships
description: Two relationships, an OR group inside an AND filter, and recent cases.
xml:
<fetch top="100">
  <entity name="incident">
    <attribute name="ticketnumber" />
    <attribute name="title" />
    <attribute name="createdon" />
    <filter type="and">
      <condition attribute="createdon" operator="last-x-days" value="30" />
      <filter type="or">
        <condition attribute="prioritycode" operator="eq" value="1" />
        <condition attribute="prioritycode" operator="eq" value="2" />
      </filter>
    </filter>
    <link-entity name="account" from="accountid" to="customerid" link-type="outer" alias="customer">
      <attribute name="name" alias="customer_name" />
    </link-entity>
    <link-entity name="systemuser" from="systemuserid" to="owninguser" link-type="outer" alias="owner">
      <attribute name="fullname" alias="owner_name" />
    </link-entity>
    <order attribute="createdon" descending="true" />
  </entity>
</fetch>

name: 04 · Revenue by owner
description: Aggregate and group-by source fields for reporting.
xml:
<fetch aggregate="true">
  <entity name="opportunity">
    <attribute name="ownerid" alias="owner" groupby="true" />
    <attribute name="estimatedvalue" alias="pipeline_total" aggregate="sum" />
    <attribute name="opportunityid" alias="opportunity_count" aggregate="count" />
    <filter><condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0" /></filter>
    <order alias="pipeline_total" descending="true" />
  </entity>
</fetch>

name: 05 · Accounts without contacts
description: Outer join with a post-join null condition; illustrates filtering after a link.
xml:
<fetch distinct="true">
  <entity name="account">
    <attribute name="name" />
    <link-entity name="contact" from="parentcustomerid" to="accountid" link-type="outer" alias="c">
      <attribute name="contactid" />
    </link-entity>
    <filter><condition entityname="c" attribute="contactid" operator="null" /></filter>
  </entity>
</fetch>

name: 06 · Three-level relationship
description: A multi-hop relationship across accounts, contacts and activities.
xml:
<fetch top="200">
  <entity name="account">
    <attribute name="name" />
    <link-entity name="contact" from="parentcustomerid" to="accountid" link-type="inner" alias="contact">
      <attribute name="fullname" />
      <link-entity name="task" from="regardingobjectid" to="contactid" link-type="outer" alias="task">
        <attribute name="subject" />
        <attribute name="scheduledend" />
      </link-entity>
    </link-entity>
  </entity>
</fetch>
